diameter must be positive and finite
length must be positive and finite
head_style must be one of: button, countersunk, cylindrical, hex, square
thread_style must be one of: auto, full, none, partial
thread_detail must be one of: cosmetic, modeled
thread_form must be one of: trapezoidal, v
drive_style must be one of: cross, hex_socket, none, slot
head_width must be greater than diameter
thread_pitch is required when diameter is outside the metric coarse series
partial thread_length must be smaller than length
thread_length must be positive and finite
thread_length is only valid when thread_style='partial'
drive_size and drive_depth require a non-'none' drive_style
drive_size is too large for head_width
drive_depth is too large for head_height
underhead_fillet_radius is too large for the shank and head dimensions
thread_depth must be smaller than the bolt radius
diameter and thread_pitch produce a non-positive minor diameter
modeled thread length must be greater than thread_pitch
